# Code of Conduct

Toolgrain welcomes people of every background and experience level. Everyone
participating in the project should be able to ask questions, share work, and
disagree without harassment or discrimination.

## Expectations

- Be considerate and respectful. Discuss ideas and behavior without attacking people.
- Give specific, constructive feedback and accept corrections in good faith.
- Make room for people who are learning or have a different perspective.
- Respect privacy. Share another person's private information only with their permission.

Harassment, threats, discriminatory abuse, sexual attention or content directed
at participants, doxxing, and repeated disruptive behavior are unacceptable.
These expectations apply to project issues, pull requests, reviews, and other
project spaces, and when someone represents Toolgrain publicly.

## Report a concern

Contact Keshav Katwe privately at
**[keshav.katwe@gmail.com](mailto:keshav.katwe@gmail.com)** with the subject
`Toolgrain conduct report`. Include what happened, where it happened, and any
relevant links or context. You may report behavior you experienced or witnessed.

Reports will be reviewed fairly and handled with respect for the reporter's
privacy. Information will be shared only as needed to investigate and respond.
Retaliation against someone for making a good-faith report is unacceptable.

## Moderation

The maintainer may ask for a change in behavior, remove harmful content, limit
participation, or exclude a participant temporarily or permanently. The response
will consider the severity, impact, and any repeated behavior. Serious threats or
harassment may require immediate action. Reasons will be communicated to the
people involved when appropriate.
